A manual operation requires your attention for every order. A sovereign store processes orders identically whether you are watching or not, whether it is midnight or noon, whether it receives one order or fifty simultaneously. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain continuously. The webhook fires the moment a transaction receives on-chain confirmations. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your Supabase database, generates a presigned download URL from Cloudflare R2 with a configurable expiry time, and sends the delivery email via Resend. The buyer receives their product before they have navigated away from the payment confirmation page.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting language that integrates with Google Workspace to automate tasks. For digital commerce, it serves as the backbone for automating product delivery, enabling creators to send download links immediately after payment verification. This process is essential for maintaining customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, especially in markets where traditional payment processors aren't viable. With a correctly configured sovereign stack, orders can be processed in under 30 seconds, ensuring a swift and seamless customer experience.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture utilizes Google Apps Script to handle incoming webhook events from NOWPayments. When a payment is confirmed, NOWPayments triggers a webhook that sends information about the transaction to your script. The script processes this information, verifies the payment, and retrieves the corresponding digital product. It then generates and sends a download link to the buyer’s email instantly. This system operates efficiently, leveraging Cloudflare Workers, which can manage up to 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, ensuring scalability as your sales grow.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This automation framework is designed specifically for digital creators in countries with heavy restrictions on payment platforms, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela. These creators often sell digital products like eBooks, courses, and plugins, but struggle to find reliable ways to accept payments. By using Google Apps Script in conjunction with NOWPayments, they can automate their sales processes, maintain ownership of their customer data, and eliminate dependency on restrictive platforms, empowering them to focus on their craft instead of the complexities of payment processing.
Automate your digital storefront without relying on traditional payment processors.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this setup include Google Apps Script for the backend logic, NOWPayments for processing crypto payments, and a delivery mechanism such as Gmail or Resend for sending product links. The entire system is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, allowing creators to utilize free resources while ensuring that their digital storefront is robust. Together, these components create a sovereign stack that offers full control over the sales process, data, and customer interactions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own automated digital commerce system, start by setting up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site. Next, create a Google Apps Script that listens for NOWPayments webhooks. Configure the script to verify payments and send emails with download links. Ensure to test your setup thoroughly with both successful and failed transactions to confirm the reliability of your system. For those looking to expedite this process, consider the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) which provides a pre-configured solution ready for deployment.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by using webhooks to trigger scripts that handle order fulfillment. When a payment is confirmed through a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments, a webhook sends this data to your Google Apps Script. The script processes the payment details and automatically sends download links to the customer, ensuring a seamless transaction experience.
Gain full ownership of your customer data and sales processes.

Full automation means the store generates revenue while you sleep, processes orders while you travel, and delivers products while you build your next one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys this complete automated pipeline under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents every technical step for creators who prefer to build it themselves. Both available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by creating a GitHub Pages site to host your digital storefront. Set up NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions and generate webhooks. Write a Google Apps Script that listens for these webhooks and processes order details. Test the script to ensure it sends emails with download links after payment confirmation. Once verified, launch your store and begin selling digital products.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated delivery uses webhooks from payment processors like NOWPayments. When a payment is confirmed, a webhook sends details to your Google Apps Script, which then verifies the payment and sends the customer a download link.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a user-defined HTTP callback that triggers an action when a specific event occurs. In this context, when NOWPayments confirms a transaction, it sends a webhook to your script, initiating the fulfillment process.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?
Yes, by configuring Google Apps Script to process webhooks from NOWPayments, you can automatically send download links to customers once their payment is verified.
What are the benefits of using Google Apps Script for automation?

Google Apps Script allows for seamless integration with Google services, enabling you to automate tasks efficiently. It is cost-effective, easy to use, and requires no additional infrastructure, making it ideal for digital creators.
How do I ensure my setup is secure and reliable?

To ensure security, validate incoming webhook requests and implement error handling in your scripts. Regularly test your setup to confirm that transactions are processed correctly and that customers receive their products without issues.
